    Manheim is one of New Zealand’s largest providers of automotive auction services

    We hold weekly auctions at all of our locations around New Zealand.

    • Research

      Research vehicles online, then either attend our auctions in person or bid on a vehicle from the comfort of your home or office via Simulcast online auctions.

    • Buying & Selling

      Manheim New Zealand is part of one of the world's leading providers of used vehicle services, Manheim, and has set the standard for buying and selling vehicles at auction and via tender.

    • Search our range

      Using our new and improved search features above, Manheim makes it easier than ever before to search our extensive range to find a vehicle to suit your needs.
